name: Toolbelt
tagline: A cheat-sheet and snippet app that works without a connection.
summary: An offline-first Android cheat-sheet and snippet app for developers and students.
problem: Commands and snippets are easy to forget and slow to look up, and a lot of study and work happens without a good connection. Toolbelt keeps the things you reach for in one place on your phone, ready to copy.

features.title: Copy first
features.text: Every snippet is built to be copied in one tap.

features.title: Template fill-in
features.text: Snippets can contain {{variable}} placeholders that you fill in before copying.

features.title: Full-text search
features.text: Search across all snippets using SQLite FTS5.

features.title: Collections
features.text: Group the snippets you use together.

features.title: Usage tracking
features.text: The app keeps track of what you use.

features.title: Backup and import
features.text: Export and import your data as JSON.

features.title: Importable packs
features.text: Packs cover git, Linux, Python, Django, FastAPI, React, Docker, SQL, QA, cloud basics, networking, and data and ML, plus a pinned Study and Career pack.

howItWorks.text: Packs are imported into a local SQLite database with an FTS5 index, so search and lookup never need a network. Snippets with {{variable}} placeholders ask for values first and then copy the finished text. Your data can be backed up to, and restored from, a JSON file.

nodes.label: Packs
nodes.note: git, Linux, Python, Docker, SQL and more

thanks.text: Claude and Claude Code helped plan and write the app; I tested it and decided what shipped.
